mentions.name: Orange Juice
mentions.description: A browser extension that adds conveniences to Hacker News without changing the site's UX, including keyboard navigation, inline replies, dark mode, a nicer topcolors page, and planned social features such as following users. It is built as a well-tested, extensible codebase with minimal impact on the site and is open source under GPL.
mentions.problem: Hacker News lacks everyday convenience features, making it harder to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a browser extension to make Hacker News easier to use. No, not change the UX, but just some nice conveniences. Keyboard navigation, inline replies, dark mode, a nicer topcolors page, and many more features. I am hoping to add some social features, like being able to follow someone. All in a well-tested and extensible codebase that has minimal impact on the site. Open source, GPL...
